newsitem.title: USA: Res-Care ups line of credit to $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Res-Care ups line of credit to $65 mln.

text.p: Res-Care Inc said on Tuesday that it has entered into a new revolving credit facility with a group of banks led by PNC Bank, Kentucky which allows for maximum borrowings of $65 million.
The company said that this represents an increase of $30 million over the prior credit facility.

Including unused capacity under the prior facility, it will provide about $40 million in future borrowing capacity, to be used primarily for acquisitions and related development expenditures, the company said.
